limitations: Single consumer PC with shared desktop GPU; no CXL hardware.
Float32 dense attention retains all entries; this is not a reproduction of sparse HGCA/BEYOND.
GPU allocation is a PyTorch allocator observation, not exclusive physical VRAM residency.
Finite numerical agreement does not establish downstream language quality.

protocol.timing: CUDA-synchronized wall time; query transfers, output return and fusion included; cache preparation separate
protocol.selector: linear-median-v1; calibration rows only; no held-out observations supplied
protocol.budget_scope: Soft GPU KV selection budget only; sweep measures every plan, including ineligible plans; no whole-process quota
